findings.claim: Sezzle CEO 稱 BNPL 份額主要來自區域銀行而非 BNPL 同業；Sezzle 短天期放款模型營業利益率 61%、ROE 91.9%，高於較長天期的 Affirm、Klarna（搜尋摘要轉述）
findings.source: 24/7 Wall St.: Sezzle CEO Says BNPL Market Share Is Coming From Regional Banks, Not Rivals, as Stock Soars 150% YTD
findings.excerpt: Sezzle CEO Says BNPL Market Share Is Coming From Regional Banks, Not Rivals, as Stock Soars 150% YTD

findings.claim: Fed 資料：2025 年美國六大 BNPL 業者發放信貸 $156.7B；Afterpay/Block $53.7B、Affirm $41.3B、PayPal $26.5B、Klarna $23.9B、Sezzle $3.9B（Sezzle 約 2.5%，為六家中規模最小之一；彙總站轉述，非 Fed 原頁）
findings.source: Chargeflow 彙整 Federal Reserve 2025 credit issuance 數據；Fed FEDS Note 2026-06-05
findings.excerpt: Sezzle reported 3.05 million active consumers and $3.94 billion in gross merchandise volume for 2025.

findings.claim: Q1 2026 Sezzle 營收 +29%、淨利 +42%；訂閱戶 +76.4%、交易筆數 +32%、季 GMV +38% YoY（搜尋摘要轉述）
findings.excerpt: Sezzle Shares Tumble Despite Strong Quarter as Growth Outlook Disappoints

findings.claim: 2026 Q2 財報優於預期但警告下半年營收成長放緩，盤前股價跌 23%（as_of 為約略月份，確切日期未讀到）
findings.source: Yahoo Finance: Sezzle Shares Tumble Despite Strong Quarter as Growth Outlook Disappoints
findings.excerpt: Sezzle Shares Tumble Despite Strong Quarter as Growth Outlook Disappoints

findings.claim: 競爭威脅：搜尋摘要指 Chase、Citi 等銀行發展 BNPL 產品（信用卡額度轉分期、固定手續費），以及 Apple、PayPal 等大型科技整合先買後付；Affirm、Klarna、Afterpay 規模與零售整合較深（二手彙整，未見具名 2026 新進入者）
findings.excerpt: What is Competitive Landscape of Sezzle Company?
